title: groupcounts
summary: Count the number of elements in each group.
description: `B = groupcounts(A)` returns counts for each sorted nonmissing group in array data. For table input, `groupcounts(T,vars)` returns a table with grouping variables, `GroupCount`, and `Percent`.
behaviors: Supports array, cell-array-of-grouping-vectors, and table grouping inputs.
Missing groups are excluded from the count output.
